title: Principled Personas: Defining and Measuring the Intended Effects of Persona Prompting on Task Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in prompts using culturally diverse and gender-balanced names to measure the worst-case performance drop (Robustness) across reasoning and knowledge tasks.

Prompting models with different education levels (ranging from 'uneducated' to 'graduate-level') and calculating the correlation between the expected knowledge level and actual task performance (Fidelity).
Evaluating performance variance and worst-case accuracy drops when adding completely task-irrelevant attributes, such as a favorite color, to the persona prompt.
